itemListElement.name: All Star Fight by Buakaw at Rajadamnern Stadium

mainEntity.name: What is All Star Fight by Buakaw?

acceptedAnswer.text: All Star Fight by Buakaw is a monthly Muay Thai promotion presented by Buakaw Banchamek at Rajadamnern Stadium in Bangkok. It normally features seven professional three-round bouts involving Thai and international fighters.

mainEntity.name: Is Buakaw fighting at All Star Fight?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Buakaw is the promoter behind the event. The fighters change from month to month and are listed on the individual dated event page once confirmed.

mainEntity.name: Is All Star Fight held every month?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is scheduled as a monthly special event, normally on the last Monday of the month. Dates can change, so check the current booking calendar.

mainEntity.name: How many fights are on the card?

acceptedAnswer.text: The standard format is seven bouts, with each bout scheduled for three rounds.

mainEntity.name: Is All Star Fight the same as Rajadamnern Knockout?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They use a similar three-round format, but All Star Fight is Buakaw’s branded monthly promotion and can replace the usual Monday Knockout programme.

mainEntity.name: Is All Star Fight suitable for someone new to Muay Thai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The three-round format is straightforward to follow, while Wai Kru, traditional music and the stadium setting give first-time visitors an introduction to several important elements of Muay Thai.

mainEntity.name: Where is All Star Fight held?

acceptedAnswer.text: All Star Fight is held at Rajadamnern Stadium on Ratchadamnoen Nok Road in Bangkok.
